decks.notes: The main focus of this Grixis Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly deploying threats to pressure them. With a mix of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to control the game tempo and finish off the opponent swiftly. The inclusion of Wasteland also allows for disruption of the opponent's mana base, further hampering their ability to stabilize. Overall, this deck thrives on aggressive plays while maintaining a disruptive edge.

This deck aims to quickly generate a large amount of mana and card draw to cast multiple spells in a single turn, ultimately leading to a massive storm count. The key strategy involves using cards like Dark Ritual, Rite of Flame, and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana quickly, while cards like Brainstorm and Infernal Tutor help dig for combo pieces. Burning Wish allows for access to specific cards from the sideboard, while Ad Nauseam and Galvanic Relay provide additional methods for drawing through the deck and generating storm count. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a lethal storm of spells in a single turn.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by taxing their spells and mana with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chalice of the Void. By utilizing aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Seasoned Dungeoneer, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the game tempo. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and access to sideboard cards, while the land base includes disruptive lands like Wasteland and Cavern of Souls to further hinder the opponent's strategy.

The main strategy of this Lands deck is to control the game by slowing down the opponent with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while also assembling the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo for a quick win condition. The deck also focuses on graveyard recursion with cards like Life from the Loam and Crucible of Worlds to keep the engine going. The inclusion of utility lands like Karakas and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through resource management and strategic land plays.

This deck revolves around quickly assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo, using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library and put Narcomoeba in play. Thassa's Oracle acts as a win condition, with the support of cards like Shuko and Staff of the Storyteller. Protection is provided by cards like Force of Will and Cabal Therapy, along with disruption from Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also runs Urza's Saga for added utility and consistency. The key goal is to combo off and win the game quickly before the opponent can disrupt your plans.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a disruptive board presence through aggressive creatures and powerful lockdown effects like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere. By utilizing efficient mana acceleration and mana denial cards, the deck aims to prevent opponents from casting their spells while applying pressure with creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss. The inclusion of dragons like Fury and Cursed Mirror adds a strong finisher to the deck, allowing for quick and decisive victories in the Legacy format.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient and aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure early on. The deck also includes disruptive spells such as Thoughtseize and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws and hits its land drops. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and board wipes like Snuff Out to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, with key lands like Mystic Sanctuary and Wasteland included to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Goblin Welder, Painter's Servant, and Grindstone to create a combo that mills the opponent's library, ultimately winning the game. The deck also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fury to support the combo strategy. Additionally, it incorporates red disruption spells like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to efficiently assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure a victory in a Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while deploying threats to apply pressure. It utilizes a combination of efficient removal spells like Snuff Out and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats, while also leveraging disruptive creatures like Grief and Leovold, Emissary of Trest to disrupt the opponent's hand and card advantage. The deck also employs powerful graveyard recursion with cards like Reanimate and Life from the Loam to generate value. Overall, this deck aims to control the game tempo and grind out incremental advantages to secure victory.

This Aggro Canadian Threshold deck is focused on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by playing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tarmogoyf, supported by spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. The deck aims to control the game by using disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will while also maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base includes both green and red sources, allowing for flexible casting of spells and efficient land destruction with Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

This deck revolves around assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, while utilizing cards like Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Orim's Chant to protect the combo, as well as card selection and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga provides additional utility, and Teferi, Time Raveler helps to control the board. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win before the opponent can disrupt it.

This deck focuses on locking down the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Trinisphere, while quickly deploying aggressive threats such as Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss. Using fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, it aims to establish an early advantage and maintain pressure throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Cursed Mirror and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker ensures a versatile and adaptable game plan, allowing for different lines of attack depending on the matchup.

The deck heavily relies on ramping up mana quickly with artifacts like Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, while also using cards like Defense Grid to protect its combo pieces. Mystic Forge is a crucial card that allows the player to dig deep into their deck and play important artifacts for free. Combining cards like Mesmeric Orb with Lion's Eye Diamond can lead to explosive turns, and Karn, the Great Creator provides utility by shutting down opposing artifacts. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of fast mana producing cards, card draw and discard spells, along with tutors and a powerful storm combo finisher to quickly assemble and cast a lethal Tendrils of Agony. The deck aims to generate a large storm count through cheap spells and rituals, allowing for a massive Tendrils of Agony to be cast, draining the opponent's life total in one turn. The deck is built around efficiency, speed, and resilience to disruption, aiming to win the game before the opponent can respond.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and creatures to quickly put pressure on the opponent. Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent are used to beat down the opponent while disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Spell Pierce protect the board state. Card selection and manipulation are key with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Chart a Course, ensuring the deck is consistent and can find the cards it needs. Lightning Bolt and other damage spells provide reach to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to control the game early and snowball into victory.

This UWx Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing card advantage and card selection with cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, Narset, and Teferi. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Dress Down and The Wandering Emperor to disrupt opposing strategies. The win condition of the deck is to outvalue the opponent while maintaining control of the game, ultimately leading to victory through attrition. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.
